verdict.line: You lose if she chains Q (Darkin Daggers) into W (Eviscerate) and E (Bite) before your Grit bar is full at level 2-3; you win any trade that goes past 3 seconds once your W (Haymaker) is up.

brief.thesis: Naafiri is a burst-and-reset skirmisher whose all-in lives or dies on her E (Bite) cooldown and how many Darkin packmates her passive has spawned; Sett is a grindy duelist whose W (Haymaker) heals off missing HP, so the matchup is a race between her front-loaded burst window and your sustained-trade window. Whoever forces the fight on their own terms wins it — she wants to open and disengage fast, you want to extend and out-heal.

theirWindow.when: Level 2, right after she lands Q poke
theirWindow.what: She'll chain W (Eviscerate) dash into E (Bite) for a full burst combo before you have W leveled. Play for space, don't stand in the Q dagger cone pre-6, and don't contest CS in melee range until you have at least one Grit-full auto banked.

yourWindow.when: Her E (Bite) is on cooldown or she's used W to farm
yourWindow.what: Walk up and force extended contact — she has no gap-closer left to disengage with, so land your grabbed E (Face Slam), pop empowered Facebreaker autos, and let W (Haymaker) heal you back through whatever Q chip she gets in.

start.why: Negates her Q (Darkin Daggers) poke damage per hit and lets you sit on CS without losing the passive-regen war.

boots.why: Naafiri's damage is almost entirely physical (Q daggers, on-hit W/E), so flat AA damage reduction outvalues tenacity here.

core.why: The proc heals off her burst and the crit-conversion punishes her low base armor in short trades.
The slow from Spellblade catches her mid-dash out of W (Eviscerate), and the extra damage keeps you relevant into a full-build Naafiri.
The shield directly counters her burst-reset combo and keeps you alive through the R (packmate) all-in.

situational.when: she's ahead on kills and her passive packmate count is snowballing her fights
she rushes crit/on-hit items and starts one-shotting you out of W (Eviscerate) execute range
she's kiting you with W/E dashes instead of standing to trade

runes.keystoneWhy: You want the fight to last past her initial burst window — Conqueror's ramping adaptive force rewards exactly the extended trades your W heal is built for.

summoners.why: Naafiri has no self-peel once E (Bite) is down; Ignite closes out the all-in windows you win and denies any lifesteal she's built.

playing.title: Manage the wave before E
playing.detail: Face Slam grabs the nearest unit, not Naafiri specifically — if minions sit between you, your pull whiffs onto a minion. Thin or freeze the wave so she's the closest target when you commit.

playing.title: Punish her E (Bite) cooldown
playing.detail: Bite is her only true gap closer besides the W dash. The moment she uses it to poke or reposition, walk up and force a trade she can't cleanly exit.

playing.title: Bank W (Haymaker) for mid-trade, not pre-trade
playing.detail: The heal scales with missing HP, so popping it after eating her burst maximizes the heal-back and flips the extended fight your way.

playing.title: Count her passive packmates
playing.detail: Every kill or assist near her spawns a Darkin packmate that adds real DPS. Check how many are active before diving — a 2-packmate Naafiri hits far harder than a solo one.

playing.title: Threaten first at level 6
playing.detail: The Show Stopper's damage is percent max HP, making it proportionally scarier to her thin frame than her kit is to yours. Look to force the all-in the moment your ult is up if her R isn't.

playing.title: Disengage below 40% HP
playing.detail: Eviscerate deals bonus execute-style damage to low-HP targets. If you drop under that threshold, back off instead of finishing the trade — that's exactly when her W spikes hardest.

brief.patchCaveat: Ability names/numbers for Naafiri (especially her R) and current item availability (Sundered Sky, Steraks Gage, Trinity Force) reflect the build as I last knew it — verify these haven't been reworked or renamed on your current patch before locking runes and item order.
